messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: libicuuc.so / ucol_close_49 issue
parts:
I've been using RApache on my ArchLinux box without a problem for few years now. After recent upgrade (-Syu), I cannot start httpd.service. At first, systemctl status httpd.sevice  returns this. Then I figured out that it has to do something with symlinks in /usr/lib folder:

lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root       16 Nov 10 21:54 libicuuc.so -> libicuuc.so.50.1
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root       16 Nov 20 20:12 libicuuc.so.49 -> libicuuc.so.50.1
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root       16 Nov 10 21:54 libicuuc.so.50 -> libicuuc.so.50.1
-rwxr-xr-x  1 root root  1514104 Nov 10 21:54 libicuuc.so.50.1

I symlinked libicuuc.so, and got an error about libicui18n.so.49 afterwards. So once again, symlinked libicui18n.so and got this when upon service start:

➜  ~/packages/R/rapache git:(master) ✗ sudo systemctl start httpd.service
Job for httpd.service failed. See 'systemctl status httpd.service' and 'journalctl -n' for details.
➜  ~/packages/R/rapache git:(master) ✗ sudo systemctl status httpd.service
httpd.service - Apache Web Server
      Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/system/httpd.service; disabled)
      Active: failed (Result: exit-code) since Tue, 2012-11-20 20:15:30 CET; 4s ago
     Process: 13797 ExecStart=/usr/sbin/apachectl start (code=exited, status=1/FAILURE)
      CGroup: name=systemd:/system/httpd.service

Nov 20 20:15:30 quickie systemd[1]: Starting Apache Web Server...
Nov 20 20:15:30 quickie apachectl[13797]: httpd: Syntax error on line 124 of /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf: Cannot load /etc/httpd/modules/mod_R.so into server: /usr/lib/R/lib/libR.so: undefined sy... ucol_close_49
Nov 20 20:15:30 quickie systemd[1]: Failed to start Apache Web Server.
Nov 20 20:15:30 quickie systemd[1]: Unit httpd.service entered failed state

Note that I've recompiled the module after symlinking. And the message is truncated, it says: undefined symbol:

Any ideas what may have caused this?

aL3xa

messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Re: libicuuc.so / ucol_close_49 issue
parts:
False alert (maybe). I reinstalled R and it works like a charm now. Dunno what's the catch, but it works now. Me happy. Very happy.

aL3xa
